comment: Registry for tools and files in the PS5 ffpfsc/ffpkg/fpkg compressed-game ecosystem. Three subtypes: 'compressor_tool' (ELF/BIN that runs on the PS5 and compresses/decompresses games), 'helper_elf' (supporting ELF utilities for verifying, mounting, or patching ffpfsc content), 'compressed_file' (an actual .ffpfsc/.ffpkg/.fpkg compressed game image -- note: PLUZ5 will not host full game images; this subtype exists for metadata/catalog purposes only). All entries follow the same naming convention as payload_registry.json: {identity}[-{variant}]_v{version}[_Expi{YYYYMMDD}].{ext}. Optional 'platform' field: absent = ps5. Optional 'fw_min'/'fw_max' for console firmware compatibility.

default.author: juma-sayeh
default.note: Console-side PS5 game compressor. Compresses installed game titles to ffpfsc/ffpkg format to reclaim internal storage while keeping the game playable. Reference implementation for KmprZu's compression addon.

default.author: drakmor
default.note: AMPR (Asset Pack) emulator. Enables loading of custom/modified AMPR asset packs inside PS5 games without modifying the game's main executable. Required by games that use AMPR for DLC/patch asset delivery.

default.author: drakmor
default.note: DLC emulator. Enables loading of DLC content without the original entitlement. Works alongside ampr_emu for games that deliver DLC via AMPR asset packs. See also: drakmor/dlc_emu releases for versioned .elf builds.

default.author: Nazky
default.note: Simplified AMPR/LZ4 asset-pack builder for PS5 games. Automates the process of creating and injecting custom AMPR asset packs. Companion tool to ampr_emu.

default.author: gameboy829
default.note: On-console AMPR LZ4 asset-pack converter (beta.1, GPL-3.0-or-later). Browser UI on port 5911; needs ShadowMountPlus + Payload Manager. LZ4 HC level 7 default, content verification on by default, original handling: keep/delete/move/swap. Upstream release file is LZ4-Game-Compressor-beta.1.elf -- rename to the PLUZ convention before hosting. Uses ampr_emu code. fw fields left unset (not stated by the repo).

default.author: theghostonline
default.note: On-console LZ4 asset-pack + .ffpfsc compressor with native PS5 app (PPSA99420) and engine lz4-compression.elf on port 5920. Also does validate/repair, uncompress, move, APR-EMU version picker, job history. Console-tested by author on FW 13.60 with kstuff-lite 1.11 and ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta3/4; requires ShadowMountPlus, kstuff-lite 1.07+, Payload Manager. Ships pldmgr metadata (payload-manager/lz4-compression.elf.json) and SHA256SUMS per release. Built on juma-sayeh/PS5-Game-Compressor and Lazy_AMPR. No LICENSE file shown on the repo page -- check before mirroring the binary. fw fields left unset.

default.author: ViiNCENZO10
default.note: On-console game to AMPR LZ4 converter (GPL-3.0-or-later). Web UI on port 6972, plus a home-screen app (PPSA99272.ffpkg, controller-driven). Queue, pause/resume surviving reboot, per-game TOML profiles, trace-based profile optimizer, --auto mode. Needs an ELF loader on port 9021 and ShadowMountPlus 1.7+. WARNING: author states it is NOT yet tested on a console (CI only). Single-commit repo; AMPR is beta and a format change would require a packer update. fw fields left unset.
